tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: We've been discussing the impact of cultural globalization on local traditions. Some anthropologists argue that cultural globalization leads to the loss of unique and diverse cultural identities, while others believe it promotes cultural exchange and understanding. What is your perspective on the impact of cultural globalization on local traditions?

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: I believe cultural globalization can lead to the loss of unique cultural identities. As global culture becomes more dominant, traditional practices and languages can be forgotten or replaced. It's important to preserve and celebrate local cultures to maintain diversity.

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: In my opinion, cultural globalization promotes cultural exchange and understanding. It allows people to learn about and appreciate different cultures. This exchange can enrich local traditions and create a more interconnected and tolerant world.
